incident.title: Delayed log ingestion in one region

updates.body: Logs shipped to our EU region are arriving with a delay of up to four minutes. Nothing is lost; live tail is behind by the same amount.
A storage node fell behind on compaction, so writes queued behind it. We have added capacity and the backlog is draining.
The delay is under ten seconds again. We are watching the backlog finish.
Resolved. Every queued log line has been written.

incident.title: SMS notifications delayed for some carriers

updates.body: Some text messages are arriving several minutes late. Phone calls, push and email alerts are on time.
One of our SMS providers is degraded. We have moved traffic to the second provider.
Messages are being delivered on time on every carrier we test. Resolved.

incident.title: Slow and failing queries over long time ranges
incident.markdown:
## Impact

For 70 minutes, about one in eight queries covering more than seven days timed out, and dashboards built on them showed empty charts. Shorter queries, ingestion and alerting were not affected.

## Timeline

1. 14:02 UTC — a schema migration starts on the query cluster
2. 14:11 UTC — the long-range query latency alert fires
3. 14:40 UTC — the migration is paused and its index build cancelled
4. 15:12 UTC — query latency is back to normal

## What caused it

The migration rebuilt an index on every node at once instead of one node at a time, so long-range queries lost the index they depend on.

## What we changed

Migrations on the query cluster now roll one node at a time and stop by themselves when query latency rises.

updates.body: Queries over long time ranges are slow or timing out. We are investigating.
A maintenance job on the query cluster is competing with queries. We have paused it.
Query times are back to normal. We are monitoring.
Resolved. A full write-up follows below.

incident.title: Query cluster upgrade
incident.markdown: We are upgrading the query cluster one node at a time. Queries keep working; some may take a few seconds longer during the window. Ingestion and alerting are not affected.
